name: aioff
description: AI Off: one switch that removes AI from your browser, computer, phone, and network. Contains no AI.

scripts.test: pnpm rules:build && pnpm --filter @aioff/extension exec wxt prepare && vitest run
scripts.site:build: pnpm rules:build && pnpm dns:build && pnpm --filter @aioff/site build
scripts.build: pnpm rules:build && pnpm dns:build && pnpm policies:build && pnpm --filter @aioff/extension build:all && pnpm --filter @aioff/site build
